out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Super high-pitched noise that was both heard and felt; painful to hear; felt like bouncing from ceiling to floor.

arrival.other_being_detail: Two white light beings shaped like people; later a beautiful man who brought a scroll; later a great multitude of people communicating telepathically.

environment.environment_other_detail: “World of lights” with sparkling/glittery diamond-like quality; pristine plants; crystal-like building with 12 clear walls/foundations with colored English names; room/office with floor-to-ceiling see-through wall overlooking Earth; later a house with a reflection pond; a room with a great multitude of people; traveled through space; water parting like the Red Sea.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Wanted to return after seeing future happiness and “all the people I was going to save and bring to God,” but was scared due to abuse at home; also asked not to stay long.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Jesus told her what to do on Earth: “Love and have fun”; she also saw herself helping “bring [people] to God.”

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Leg cut open; later surgery with anesthesia gas.

person_demographics.religious_background_detail: Mentions Jehovah Witness teaching about death as “eternal sleep state.”
person_demographics.religious_belief_at_nde_detail: Prayed/asked God questions; explicitly contrasts experience with Jehovah Witness doctrine.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Future life preview on a see-through wall; “doorway” into/through light; merging with light; telepathic reassurance/teaching; travel through space and into water; re-entry sensation described in sternum and “bouncing around” inside limbs.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Life review occurred at the moment of impact (before hospital/surgery). Later, during anesthesia: OBE in operating room → black void → approaching light/merging → beings/doorway → heavenly realm and encounters → future preview → decision/return → re-entry.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Reports multiple simultaneous perspectives (watching herself with “three different perspectives” plus “360-degree view”).

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Multiple-perspective viewing (three perspectives + 360°); entering/merging with light and later seeing self again; going into a tree to hide and realizing she could pass through it; a “scroll” signed by Jesus at a podium; Jesus “got into me” (shared perception); water parting while traveling in a sphere; explicit re-entry point at bottom of sternum and sensation of bouncing through limbs before reconnecting.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was on the ceiling, completely calm and peaceful.” / “BOOM in a black space. It was blacker than black and completely void.” / “one's mind can't express in words the feelings of immense LOVE.” / “This is your HOME and you can go anywhere you wish.” / “There is nothing you could do that could ever change the way God feels about you.” / “Love and have fun.” / “the body needed to breathe, not YOU.”
